tools.name: trestle_validate_phone
tools.description: Check a phone number with Trestle Phone Validation. Returns whether it is valid, its country and carrier, its line type (Mobile, Landline, FixedVOIP, NonFixedVOIP, TollFree and so on), whether it is prepaid, and a 0-100 activity score (70 or above: likely connected; 30 or below: likely disconnected

tools.name: trestle_check_tcpa_litigator
tools.description: Validate a US phone number and run Trestle's TCPA litigator check. Returns add_ons.litigator_checks['phone.is_litigator_risk']: true when the subscriber is a known TCPA litigator, null when the check could not finish. US numbers only.
